text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't it be hilarious if I lost again? I'd be, like, the worst ever.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But seriously, what do I even do if I lose today? Ughhh, my heart's pounding…
choice_data_list: Even if you're nervous, all you can do is give it your best shot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not, like… nervous or whatever. Well… maybe a little…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My best shot, huh… I guess that's all there is to it. This stupid feeling won't disappear unless I win.
